_help: SSMT alerts sent to Telegram by .github/workflows/prices.yml while the app is closed. levels: which predicted cycles to watch and which market groups (idx = ES NQ YM RTY, fx = EU GU DXY, met = Gold Silver Plat, cry = BTC ETH SOL). ssmt: send when an SSMT forms; tcisd: send when the tCISD confirms (the entry).
